text.text_excerpt: Finally I was able to get a waffle! Unfortunately, It tasted like the batter is really a mix made by some large company is some random part of the country. And the syrup I was given was Chef's Mark I believe... That's a private label brand of sysco, sams, or conco. That made me very disillusioned, that my syrup was runny & cheap. I understand the economics of running a restaurant but that syrup should be homemade or at least a quality brand. The chicken was absolutely awesome and the young lady that took/prepared/served my order was courteous, playful, and honest. I told here I wanted the punch and said I can't have too much sugar though, is it too sweet? she replied, Yea it probably will...

Oh yeah this is the good stuff. Got the 6pc wings (Katrina) and waffle (under $10). Added on a mac & cheese too, because one can not have too much comfort food. The wings could have been spicier. (side note: in New Orleans if something is labeled spicy and/or hot, that is equal to fatally hot outside of the state). Waffle was the right amount of crispy and good. Mac & cheese was quite good. Something was missing. Most likely it is because I am used to my own version. Still this stuff was worth ordering again.

Drove in from a veeeeeeeeeerrrrrrrrrrrryyyyyyyyyyy long way. This place is next to the hotel and the only thing that was open around here! The location.. No comment. But the chicken and waffles, speechless. I think I may get the waffles for breakfast tomorrow :) Took one star of cause the joint has no air conditioning and it's August on NOLA!
